official_measurement_examples: registered title can record benefit or burden of legal easements
a deed may contain rights that are not all legal easements
implied and prescriptive easements require separate evidence routes
a licence is not automatically an easement
title register can refer to a filed deed for full wording
plan depiction is not automatically the exact legal extent of an easement
easement evidence does not establish ownership planning permission or final development yield
core_rules: deed right is not automatically legal easement
benefit and burden must be identified
registered entry may refer to deed
plan line is not exact extent without evidence
overriding interest may not appear as simple register entry
vehicle access and pedestrian access remain distinct
easement does not prove service capacity
easement does not calculate development yield
no parcel access clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
